# **OAmP - Version 3**

***

## **ADDITIONS:**

*   **Ported OAmP to 1.21.1**
*   Added invisible trunk seat to luxorama
*   Added Vintage Wheels
*   Added the Cagouille, a second gen escargot
*   Added working police sirens to luxorama police variant
*   Added the Highwayman, a 50s Corvette
*   Added new door animations

## **FIXES:**

*   Fixed Stationawgon glovebox not having blinking anim
*   Fixed Luxorama not being able to mount Bobbleheads
*   Fixed perma-muddy exhaust on Stationwagon
*   Fixed Luxorama missing headlights & blinkers
*   fixed offroad wheel size
*   Fixed custom steering wheel interfering with escargots interactive elements
*   Fixed big gap on license text on merc
*   Fixed pixel errors on luxorama
*   Fixed frontal disc clipping on merc
*   Fixed taxi luxorama not showing up
*   fixed wrong audio pos on camaro door (right)
*   Fixed missing silver stationwagon icon

## **CHANGES**

*   Instruments now come with cars by default
*   Lowered Luxorama engine by 0.5px
*   modified offroad wheel model
*   Tweaked description colors to a lighter gray (Â§7)
*   Headlights now use a lit texture instead of pure white color when on
*   Hid all car color variants except for one for clean inventory
